query:
SELECT
                game                                                AS "game_mode!: String",
                games_played                                        AS "matches_played!: i32",
                wins                                               AS "wins!: i32",
                losses                                             AS "losses!: i32",
                draws                                              AS "draws!: i32"
            FROM user_elo
            WHERE user_id = $1
              AND games_played >= $2
            ORDER BY games_played DESC
